thread:
Zoey: Flagging something weird in Monday's KPI slide webinar registrations jumped after the launch post, but demo requests didn't move. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/weekly-kpi. anyone else seeing this?
Liam: yep saw the jump. CTR on the launch post was great. my first guess is split CTAs + partner UTM overrides.
Harper: we did two creative variants for the paid push (CTA: 'Watch webinar' vs 'Book demo') and some syndication partners rewrite utm_campaign. that can fragment routing.
Noah (Analytics): running quick counts. snippet:```SELECT utm_campaign, COUNT(*) FROM marketing.leads WHERE created_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;``` I'll attach export in a min.
dashboard-bot: Weekly KPI dashboard updated by Noah (Analytics) :bar_chart:
Priya (SalesOps): heads-up: SDRs reported two duplicate touches yesterday where both a webinar invite and a demo were sent to the same contact. pause outreach for new leads until we confirm dedupe.
Noah (Analytics): export ready: https://bigquery.redwood/exports/196123_leads.csv. found 5 utm_campaign variants for the launch, top two = 92% traffic. small tail of weird suffixes added by partners.
Zoey: action plan suggestion: (1) add a short table to the weekly deck comparing last-touch 7d vs first-touch 30d for the launch cohort, (2) normalize utm_campaign at ingestion + run a one-off rehydrate for last 48h, (3) hold SDR outreach for flagged leads until dedupe complete.
Liam: agree. don't change headline metric mid-week; add the stability view instead. gives execs both quick and contextual numbers.
Harper: I'll spin up the CTA A/B results and push a copy tweak for the next paid window so we bias top-funnel to webinar.
Priya (SalesOps): pausing outreach for flagged leads. please tag the CSV with dedupe_ids so our CRM sync doesn't create duplicates.
Noah (Analytics): running the rehydrate now. quick SQL I used:```UPDATE marketing.leads SET dedupe_id = COALESCE(existing_id, new_hash) WHERE utm_norm IS NOT NULL;``` will post summary when done.
Noah (Analytics): rehydrate completed, merged 387 duplicates. dashboard recalculated and conversion ratio aligns with pre-launch baseline. added pinned note on KPI dashboard explaining normalization and that headline remains last-touch 7d.
Zoey: thanks team. Harper, please include the CTA test and the two attribution views in tomorrow's deck. Priya, can you draft a 1-paragraph blurb for the exec slide explaining the UTM fragmentation and mitigation?
Priya (SalesOps): on it. Draft will be in this thread in ~30m for sign-off.
Liam: small follow-up for Eng/Infra: consider a lightweight ingest test to warn when distinct utm_campaign spikes >30% in 1 hour. prevents this slipping by next launch.
Zoey: good idea. assign follow-ups in Asana: ingest alert (Eng), rehydrate audit (Analytics), deck blurb (SalesOps), CTA update (Marketing Ops). we'll review in the KPI huddle tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
